name: Avatar

examples.title: Photo with Automatic Fallback
examples.code:
<Avatars spaced>
  <Avatar src="https://github.com/allxsmith.png" name="Al Smith" size="64x64" />
  <Avatar
    src="https://example.invalid/missing.jpg"
    name="Grace Hopper"
    size="64x64"
  />
</Avatars>

examples.title: Initials
examples.code:
<Avatars spaced>
  <Avatar name="Ada Lovelace" />
  <Avatar name="Grace Hopper" />
  <Avatar name="Katherine Johnson" />
</Avatars>

examples.title: Shapes
examples.code:

  <Avatar name="Circle" shape="circle" />
  <Avatar name="Rounded" shape="rounded" />
  <Avatar name="Square" shape="square" />
</Avatars>

  <Avatar name="Ada Lovelace" size="24x24" />
  <Avatar name="Ada Lovelace" size="32x32" />
  <Avatar name="Ada Lovelace" size="48x48" />

examples.title: Forwarding Props to the Image
examples.code:
<Avatar
  src="https://github.com/allxsmith.png"
  name="Al Smith"
  size="64x64"
  imageProps={{ loading: 'lazy' }}
/>

accessibility:
- Image avatars use `alt` (falling back to `name`) for their accessible name.
- Initials/icon avatars expose `role="img"` and `aria-label` (from `alt`/`name`) — unless
  rendered as a link or button, where the native link/button role and `aria-label` are used
  instead.
- **Decorative avatars:** pass an explicit `alt=""` when the avatar repeats information
  already visible next to it (e.g. beside the author's name in a comment row). The image
  stays decorative and an initials/icon avatar is skipped entirely (`aria-hidden`), avoiding
  double-speak. The opt-out never applies to a link/button avatar — an interactive element
  always keeps an accessible name (from `name`, or a generic `"Avatar"` fallback).
- A link/button avatar with no `alt`/`name` (e.g. an API that returns only a photo URL) still
  gets an `aria-label` fallback rather than rendering a nameless control.
- `as="button"` defaults to `type="button"`, so a clickable avatar inside a form doesn't
  submit it.
- The default fallback icon is `aria-hidden`.
summary: The `Avatar` component represents a person or entity as a compact image.

parts.summary: The `Avatar` component represents a person or entity as a compact image.

props.name: src
props.description: Image URL. On load error (or if absent), falls back to initials, then `icon`.

props.name: alt
props.description: Alternate text for the image (used for the accessible name in every render mode). An explicit `alt=""` marks a non-interactive avatar as decorative.

props.name: name
props.description: Derives initials and a deterministic background color when no `src` is shown.

props.name: icon
props.description: Final fallback, rendered when there is no `src`, `name`, or `initials`.

props.name: size
props.description: Preset size, or a pixel size when a number.

props.name: color
props.description: Background color for initials/icon avatars (else auto-derived from `name`).

props.name: as
props.description: Element/component to render as. Defaults to `'a'` when `href` is set, else `'figure'`.

props.name: href
props.description: When set, renders the avatar as a link.

props.name: target
props.description: Anchor target — forwarded only when rendering a link (an `a` or a custom `as` component).

props.name: rel
props.description: Anchor rel — forwarded only when rendering a link (an `a` or a custom `as` component).

props.name: imageProps
props.description: Extra props forwarded to the underlying `` (e.g. `loading`, `crossOrigin`); its `onError` is chained before the fallback fires.
